_note: Inputs for NounV2Treasury.propose(...) — pass these arrays in order. The Treasury propose() signature is (address[],uint256[],string[],bytes[],string).

# NounV2 Proposal: Add head trait `joker-card`

See proposal-joker-card/PROPOSAL.md for the full body. Single call to NounV2Descriptor.addHeads — adds one new head trait (the existing index-card head with top red and bottom blue lines swapped). Uses only colors already in the V2 palette.
